examples.arabic: ليه السما زرقا يا ماما وليه القطة بتنام على الكنبة
examples.english: Why is the sky blue, Mom, and why does the cat sleep on the sofa?
examples.transliteration: Leh el-sama zar2a ya Mama we leh el-2otta betnam 3ala el-kanaba?

examples.english: I sat on the sofa and watched television.
examples.transliteration: A'adt 'ala el kanaba w shoft televizyon.
